ns2:section.sectionText: World Cultural Assets: Loss, Recovery, and Protection. The main objective of this seminar is to promote students' thinking about ethical and policy issues with regard to the destruction, recovery and protection of cultural assets in a global environment. Topics are discussed in the historical context of World War II and contemporary issues, including civil wars and foreign occupations. The coverage of policy issues includes legal measures as well as resolutions of the UN General Assembly, Council of Europe Parliamentary Assembly, and international conferences.
